summary: Gogoro Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release on the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held April 28, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$125,000 by adding 37.5 million ordinary shares, adjournment authority if needed for proxies, and authorization for directors/officers to effect the resolutions. This is a routine capital-authority increase and procedural AGM outcome, not a special situation. No transaction, activist, or restructuring event is announced. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K reports standard corporate governance actions.
